title: SmartBroom 2026.9
body:
# A Whole New SmartBroom App

Welcome to v2026.9, we're delighted you could join us! For this year the app is fully rebuilt from the ground up with a huge number of exciting enhancements. This new foundation will enable much more in the future, so stay tuned for more updates throughout the season.

### All New for SmartBroom 4
- Background sweep data capture and bulk download
- Database for sweep data synced through iCloud
- Sweeper database with sweep history
- 'Me' sweeper
- All new raw live data mode
- Sweeps grouped into sessions (practice or game)
- Sweeps broken into intervals (for gaps in a single sweep)
- Stroke-by-stroke measurement and display
- Plow stroke detection

### Improvements For Older SmartBrooms
- SmartBroom 2 or 3 .csv sweep files can be imported into the synced database and assigned to sweepers
- Imported sweeps sync through iCloud
- New live sweeps use the sweeper database
